resources.string: Emergency vibration: long, long, long. Repeats until you dismiss the alert, for up to one minute.
Traffic vibration: short-short, pause. Three times.
Each category has its own vibration, so you can tell them apart by feel. Tap Try to feel it.
Each category has its own vibration. This phone cannot vibrate, so the patterns are shown here only.
Long, long, long. Repeats until you dismiss the alert (up to one minute).
Vibration is on for alerts. You can turn it off in Settings. Try works either way. The watch app will use the same patterns.
Vibration is off for alerts, so alerts only show on the screen. You can turn it on in Settings. Try still lets you feel each pattern.
AGAP listens for 13 sounds in three categories. Each category has its own colour, badge shape and vibration.

Sample alerts only · microphone off · not saved

Demonstration Mode is a backup for presentations, for when live detection is not reliable in the room.

While it is on, a striped banner shows on every screen, the microphone stays off, Live Captions plays sample sentences, and you can show any of the 13 alerts by hand. Sample alerts look and vibrate like real ones but are never saved to Event History.

It turns off when you tap Exit, close AGAP, or restart the phone. Do not use it during tests.
Opens Live Captions. Choose English or Filipino, then tap Start.
Sample alerts use the same screen and vibration as real alerts. They are not saved.
Demonstration Mode is on: Start plays sample sentences in the chosen language. The microphone stays off.
How sure AGAP must be before it alerts. Higher means fewer false alerts but more missed quiet sounds.

AGAP (Advancing Greater Access to Communication for Persons with Hearing Impairments) is a research prototype made for a student study at Pasig City Science High School.

It is a supplementary tool. It is not a medical device, and it is not the only way to notice emergencies. Keep using other ways to notice alarms and warnings.

AGAP works without the internet. It does not record or save audio, has no user accounts, and keeps its alert history on this phone.
